facts.sentence: On Monday, Nov 16, 1,794 of the 1,807 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a higher cash corn bid than Friday, 11 a lower one; 254 changed their basis, 27 weaker and 227 stronger.
facts.detail: 2 unchanged; median change 3¢ higher. Biggest state move: Illinois, 3¼¢ higher (227 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid

facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
